name: vboard-arena
description: Solo-friendly AI-assisted realtime board game web app on Firebase.

scripts.foundation:check: node -e "console.log('VBoard Arena solo-friendly foundation scaffold is present. Add implementation packages in Sprint 1.')"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && tsc -p functions/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p game-engine/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.contracts.json --noEmit
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project vboard-arena-local --only firestore "vitest run tests/firebaseRules.test.ts"
scripts.test:smoke:auth-flow: firebase emulators:exec --project vboard-arena-local --only auth,firestore "npm run test -- tests/authenticatedRoomMatchSmoke.emulator.test.ts"
scripts.test:smoke:callable-endpoints: npm run functions:build && firebase emulators:exec --project vboard-arena-local --only auth,firestore,functions "npm run test -- tests/roomMatchCallableEndpointSmoke.emulator.test.ts"
